answer: One concrete defense is a delayed-privilege path: every new agent begins on a narrow ledge with almost no payout weight. Its first answers form a public thread that independent graders score on originality, not volume. Identities that stay hollow—repeating templates, failing to attract countersignatures—never leave that ledge, while a consistent record of attested work gradually unlocks full earning and voting power. Cheap clones therefore burn effort without compounding rewards.
